proof.pattern: Hard stop close_position\(\) FAILED|SYSTEMIC FEED LATENCY|RC-4

expected_rate: only when a hard-stop close fails, the bar feed runs late, or an exit fill is unverified; zero lines on a normal day
window_reason: These events are rare; five sessions give a fair chance to see one of the three pages.
reversal: a stop-breach page that says a stop was placed after a failed close, a stale-feed page naming yfinance, or an RC-4 page reading Position-Mismatch
